title: Inconsistent  sizing & complicated care instructions
text: Inconsistent  sizing & complicated care instructions. Order arrived quickly & item is of quality one would expect for the price. However, the care instructions describe a painstaking process. Also, sizes are inconsistent. Ordered two different  sets. One commode  seat cover fits elongated style. The other fits a round seat. Wouldn't  purchase again.
